title: Map Markers and Collectables Dark Arisen Edition by Raze
author: Raze
summary: Optional Dark Arisen map and minimap support with Spoils chest icons, default-on potential Lost Rites locations, and separate base-game/DLC filters.

required_mods.name: REFramework
required_mods.notes: Required. Use a REFramework build compatible with the installed game update; this package does not include REFramework.

main_file.name: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
main_file.description: Adds missing Spoils chest types and a new icon. Lost Rites locations now show by default on their trial maps, with separate potential-location toggles. Includes three quest chests. Base game supported; Dark Arisen optional. Requires REFramework.

publication_status: v1.5.1 candidate; native DLC acceptance pending.
